decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and supports the firm's ergonomic workplace positioning, so with no new negative evidence management attributes modest results to a normal ramp-up and stays committed.

The publicly announced G2 generation of a core interior luminaire is central to the LED portfolio and represents sunk development investment, which makes withdrawal after only two years hard to justify.

As a presented flagship of the firm's direction, the microprismatic pendant carries the highest public commitment, so management would attribute any weakness to temporary market conditions and persist.

With two sibling marine lines already withdrawn, the marine searchlight is more exposed, but management keeps it as the remaining anchor of its robust specialist marine offering to justify past investment in the niche.
